steps.name: FileAnalysisResult
steps.description: FileAnalysisResult contains the extracted model elements from analyzing a single file.

steps.name: Analyzer
steps.description: Analyzer implements static analysis for C# and Razor/Blazor source files using tree-sitter.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new C# Analyzer.

steps.name: Analyzer.CanAnalyze
steps.description: CanAnalyze returns true for .cs and .razor extensions.

steps.name: Analyzer.AnalyzeFile
steps.description: AnalyzeFile parses C# or Razor/Blazor files.

steps.name: Analyzer
steps.description: Analyzer implements static analysis for workflow XML and SSIS packages.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new Flow XML Analyzer.

steps.name: Analyzer.CanAnalyze
steps.description: CanAnalyze returns true for .xml and .dtsx extensions.

steps.name: Analyzer.AnalyzeFile
steps.description: AnalyzeFile unmarshals workflow XML definitions into canonical ProcessModel elements.

steps.name: Analyzer
steps.description: Analyzer implements static analysis for Go source files.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new Go Analyzer.

steps.name: Analyzer.CanAnalyze
steps.description: CanAnalyze returns true if the extension is .go.

steps.name: Analyzer.AnalyzeFile
steps.description: AnalyzeFile parses Go source code and extracts endpoints, DB queries, gRPC registrations, and function calls.

steps.name: isGRPCHandler
steps.description: isGRPCHandler checks if a function signature matches gRPC handler pattern.

steps.name: isHTTPHandlerFunc
steps.description: isHTTPHandlerFunc checks if a function signature matches http.HandlerFunc.

steps.name: extractHTTPRoute
steps.description: extractHTTPRoute detects HTTP route registration calls.

steps.name: extractDBQuery
steps.description: extractDBQuery detects database calls like Query, Exec, Find, Create, etc.

steps.name: Analyzer
steps.description: Analyzer implements static analysis for Python files using tree-sitter.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new Python Analyzer.

steps.name: Analyzer.AnalyzeFile
steps.description: AnalyzeFile parses Python files and extracts endpoints, functions, and call chains.

steps.name: Analyzer
steps.description: Analyzer implements static analysis for SQL scripts and queries.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new SQL Analyzer.

steps.name: Analyzer.AnalyzeFile
steps.description: AnalyzeFile parses SQL scripts and extracts table operations, views, stored procedures, and queries.

steps.name: Analyzer
steps.description: Analyzer implements static analysis for SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) .dtsx packages.

steps.name: dtsxNode
steps.description: dtsxNode represents a node in the XML hierarchy with normalized attribute lookups.

steps.name: connInfo
steps.description: connInfo stores parsed metadata about a connection manager.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new SSIS Analyzer.

steps.name: Analyzer.CanAnalyze
steps.description: CanAnalyze returns true for .dtsx and SSIS .xml files.

steps.name: Analyzer.AnalyzeFile
steps.description: AnalyzeFile unmarshals SSIS package XML definitions into canonical ProcessModel elements.

steps.name: RunAnalyze
steps.description: RunAnalyze executes the full CodeFlow analysis pipeline.

steps.name: Engine
steps.description: Engine correlates steps across multi-language components and unifies them into a canonical ProcessModel.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new Correlation Engine.

steps.name: Engine.Correlate
steps.description: Correlate takes file analysis results and produces a correlated ProcessModel.

steps.name: DiscoveredFile
steps.description: DiscoveredFile contains metadata about a recognized source file.

steps.name: Scanner
steps.description: Scanner handles filesystem traversal and file filtering.

steps.name: NewScanner
steps.description:
NewScanner creates a new Scanner instance for the given root directory.
Optional excludes can be provided as folder names, relative paths (to cwd or to source root),
absolute paths, or file glob patterns (e.g. *_test.go, test_*.py, *.spec.ts).

steps.name: NewScannerWithOptions
steps.description: NewScannerWithOptions creates a new Scanner instance with configurable .gitignore handling.

steps.name: MapExtensionToLanguage
steps.description: MapExtensionToLanguage maps a file extension to its recognized canonical language.

steps.name: Scanner.Scan
steps.description: Scan performs filesystem discovery and returns matching source files.

steps.name: matchPattern
steps.description: matchPattern evaluates glob patterns including wildcards, base name matching, and double-star (**).

steps.name: Enricher
steps.description: Enricher enriches technical AST steps into business-readable descriptions using AI.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new AI Enricher with environment keys.

steps.name: Enricher.SetClient
steps.description: SetClient allows injecting a custom HTTPClient for testing.

steps.name: Enricher.SetMockHandler
steps.description: SetMockHandler allows mock AI responses in unit tests.

steps.name: Enricher.Enrich
steps.description: Enrich processes steps in ProcessModel and updates their descriptions.

steps.name: Exporter
steps.description: Exporter converts a ProcessModel into Visio Data Visualizer compatible workbooks.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new Excel Exporter.

steps.name: Exporter.Export
steps.description: Export creates a standard single-sheet Visio Data Visualizer compatible Excel file at outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportCustomWorkbook
steps.description:
ExportCustomWorkbook creates an interactive, multi-sheet Excel Data Visualizer custom workbook.
This workbook provides an in-Excel visual process navigator and complete dependency traceability
that functions without requiring the retired Microsoft Visio Data Visualizer add-in.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new JSON Exporter.

steps.name: Exporter.Export
steps.description: Export serializes the ProcessModel to the specified file path in JSON format.

steps.name: Exporter
steps.description: Exporter converts a ProcessModel into Mermaid diagrams.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new Mermaid Exporter.

steps.name: Exporter.Export
steps.description: Export writes the default top-down flowchart (.mmd) to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportFlowchart
steps.description: ExportFlowchart writes a flowchart (TD or LR) diagram to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportJourney
steps.description: ExportJourney writes a universal journey flowchart (flowchart LR) to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportSequence
steps.description: ExportSequence writes a sequence diagram (sequenceDiagram) to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportERDiagram
steps.description: ExportERDiagram writes an Entity-Relationship diagram (erDiagram) to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportStateDiagram
steps.description: ExportStateDiagram writes a state diagram (stateDiagram-v2) to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportMarkdown
steps.description: ExportMarkdown writes the specified diagram wrapped inside a standard markdown code block.

steps.name: Exporter.Generate
steps.description: Generate returns the default flowchart TD representation.

steps.name: Exporter.GenerateFlowchart
steps.description:
GenerateFlowchart returns a Mermaid flowchart (TD or LR) styled to match modern vector graphics.
It maps node IDs to compact short IDs to stay within Mermaid's character limit.

steps.name: Exporter.GenerateJourney
steps.description:
GenerateJourney outputs a Universal Journey Flowchart using the standard 'flowchart LR' header.
This is 100% compatible with all Markdown previewers and GitHub/IDE renderers.

steps.name: Exporter.GenerateSequenceDiagram
steps.description: GenerateSequenceDiagram outputs a Mermaid sequenceDiagram showing interactions across swimlanes.

steps.name: Exporter.GenerateStateDiagram
steps.description: GenerateStateDiagram outputs a Mermaid stateDiagram-v2 showing process state progression.

steps.name: Exporter.GenerateERDiagram
steps.description: GenerateERDiagram returns a Mermaid Entity-Relationship diagram (erDiagram).

steps.name: Exporter.GenerateRawJourney
steps.description: GenerateRawJourney outputs native Mermaid 'journey' syntax (for engines supporting the keyword).

steps.name: Exporter
steps.description: Exporter converts a ProcessModel into SVG vector diagrams.

steps.name: New
steps.description: New creates a new SVG Exporter.

steps.name: Exporter.Export
steps.description: Export writes the ProcessModel as a Flowchart TD SVG file to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportFlowchart
steps.description: ExportFlowchart writes a Flowchart (TD or LR) SVG to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportJourney
steps.description: ExportJourney writes a Customer/Data Journey SVG to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportSequenceDiagram
steps.description: ExportSequenceDiagram writes a Lifeline Sequence Diagram SVG to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportStateDiagram
steps.description: ExportStateDiagram writes a UML State Machine SVG to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.ExportERDiagram
steps.description: ExportERDiagram writes an Entity-Relationship SVG to outputPath.

steps.name: Exporter.Generate
steps.description: Generate renders the default SVG (Flowchart TD).

steps.name: Exporter.GenerateFlowchart
steps.description: GenerateFlowchart renders either a TD (top-to-bottom) or LR (left-to-right) flowchart SVG.

steps.name: ProcessModel
steps.description: ProcessModel represents the top-level canonical graph of analyzed workflows.

steps.name: ASTNode
steps.description: ASTNode represents an abstract syntax tree node for code analysis.

steps.name: Step
steps.description: Step represents a discreet executable action or endpoint within a workflow.

steps.name: Link
steps.description: Link represents a directed connection or transition between two Steps.

steps.name: Swimlane
steps.description: Swimlane categorizes steps by service, domain, module, or layer.

steps.name: ProcessModel.AddSwimlane
steps.description: AddSwimlane adds a new swimlane if not already present.

steps.name: ProcessModel.AddStep
steps.description: AddStep appends a step to the model.

steps.name: ProcessModel.AddLink
steps.description: AddLink appends a link between steps.

steps.name: ProcessModel.FindStep
steps.description: FindStep finds a step by ID.

steps.name: ProcessModel.FindSwimlane
steps.description: FindSwimlane finds a swimlane by ID.
